snippet.title: Snekoban - Trailer & Release Date Announcement !
snippet.description:
Help Sneko tidy up, eat apples and take well-earned naps in Snekoban, a cute puzzle game available on Steam from January 2 2026 !

Snekoban is developped by Blessed Sleep Studio using Godot.

 You can wishlist Snekoban on Steam right now !

(There should be a link here but youtube isn't kind, sorry)
